messages:
oncall-bot: INCIDENT detected: service=model-serving cluster=eu-west-1 severity=high — error_rate /v1/generate > 7% (5m). PagerDuty: Triggering P1 page to #eng-sre.
Sam L.: I'm on call, looking now. Can someone grab logs & metrics? pinging Jordan to check infra.
Jordan P.: looking — seeing a spike in 504s from embedder nodes, CPU on g4dn-cluster at 92% and queue depth surged. Related: a recent weight update rolled to v2.3 on those pods ~10m ago.
Maya R.: fwiw customer-facing latency is slightly up but downstream retries hide some errors. We should assess true impact before blaring more pages.
Sam L.: agreed. Running a quick canary rollback to v2.2 on 2 nodes to see if error rate drops. If it does, we'll roll back cluster-wide.
Sam L.: (after 2m) rollback started on canary nodes.
Jordan P.: FYI autoscaler is slow to spin new nodes due to spot pressure in eu-west-1 — I can spin reserve instances but will take ~6m.
Sam L.: rollback succeeded on canary -> error_rate down to 1.2% on those nodes. Rolling cluster-wide now.
Leah K.: Noting that a bunch of alerts fired across regions — some were duplicate: per-pod, per-az, and aggregate. That generated a lot of noise.
PagerDuty: Acknowledged. Incident assigned to Sam L. Primary PD escalation policy applied.
Maya R.: Mitigation plan: 1) roll back to v2.2 (in progress) 2) pause non-critical experiments and traffic shaping 3) route high-volume clients to smaller model variant for short window.
Sam L.: traffic routing to model-small started. Observability shows tail latency improving.
Jordan P.: cluster-wide rollback complete. Error rate back to baseline ~0.8%. Rolling back the rollout in the release system and opening a postmortem.
Sam L.: marking customer impact: low-medium. No major outages but increased 5xx & latency for some customers; support tickets coming in.
Leah K.: Post-incident notes: bunch of paging noise from alerts that should've been ticket-only given low customer impact. We need to re-evaluate thresholds and routing policy.
Maya R.: Agreed. Proposal: change alert policy for model-serving 5xx spikes to page only if both (a) error_rate > 5% AND (b) customer-facing error-rate (slo_error_rate) > 1% for 5m. Otherwise create a P2 ticket in #incidents.
Sam L.: thumbs up. Also we should consolidate duplicate alerts (per-pod -> rollup per-cluster) and add suppression for transient spikes during rollouts (suppress if new deployment started <10m).
Jordan P.: I'll draft new alert rules. Quick example of how I'd represent the new rule in Prometheus Alertmanager form:

- alert: ModelServingHighErrorRate
  expr: job:model_errors:rate5m{route="/v1/generate"} > 0.05
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://redwood.infr/runbooks/model-serving-error

Then add a route that checks slo_error_rate metric and downgrades to ticket if slo_error_rate < 0.01.
Maya R.: And for Alertmanager routing, something like:

routes:
- match:
    severity: page
  continue: false
  receiver: pager-duty-primary
- match_re:
    cluster: ".*"
  receiver: incidents-channel
  group_wait: 30s

Ryan O.: I'll update PD escalation mapping after rules are in place — mapping low-severity (ticket) -> #incidents, P1 pages -> PD.
Leah K.: Action items: 
- Jordan: PR with new aggregated alerts + suppression logic (owner: @Jordan P.)
- Maya: update routing rules and the policy doc (owner: @Maya R.)
- Ryan: PD escalation mapping update & test (owner: @Ryan O.)
- Sam: draft postmortem and customer impact summary (owner: @Sam L.)

Sam L.: I'll create the incident page and add a timeline. Also adding a short-term tweak: increase the error-rate threshold to 6% for eu-west-1 for the next 24h while we monitor, to reduce noisy pages until fixes are merged. Will note in incident page.
Maya R.: Please also add a new dashboard tile: aggregated error-rate by build_version & region and a column for customer-facing SLOs so we can correlate deploys.
Jordan P.: will add dashboard PR. Proposed Grafana query:

sum by (build_version, region) (rate(model_errors_total[5m])) / sum by (build_version, region) (rate(model_requests_total[5m]))

Leah K.: Also adding to post-incident checklist: verify alert routing rules in staging Alertmanager, run a simulated deploy spike to ensure no noisy pages.
Sam L.: thanks all. closing P1 to on-call but keeping incident open until follow-ups are assigned. :thumbsup:
PagerDuty: Incident status changed -> acknowledged -> resolved (oncall cleared).
